title: SkillsResolveContextResult
description: Output contract for the skills_resolve_context MetaprojectOperation: the record `keryx skills resolve-context --json` prints, plus an `error` that stands in for a throw.

exceeded.description: A signal to raise gdskills.projectContext.maxBytes; no rule is cut.

undeclared.description: Present only when the project has a references file: documents a rule cites that the file does not declare (they stay on_demand).

error.description: Set when the resolve could not run; the other fields are then empty.

path.description: Project-relative, posix; absolute for a linked rule whose origin is outside the project.

reason.description: glob:<g>, always, task-type:<t>, replaces-bundled, route, bundled-default, referenced-by:<path>, or for a declared reference condition:glob:<g>, condition:keyword:<k> or declared (not promoted).

shadows.description: The bundled rule this project rule replaces.

also_at.description: Other project paths with the same sha256; citing any of them counts.

anchor.description: Declared references only: heading text or slug of the section that matters, as declared in references.json.

section_bytes.description: Declared references with an anchor: UTF-8 size of the anchored section, the bytes the obligation and the budget count.

condition.description: Declared references only: where the document applies, so an on_demand entry says why it was not required.
